item.text:
**Verdict:** Mostly yes, but uneven in practice. Lula’s 2024 agenda and several delivered programs clearly prioritized poor households, children, women, Indigenous and quilombola communities, and people with disabilities. The main counterevidence is that severe police violence against Black Brazilians persisted, the Yanomami crisis remained serious, and remote Amazon communities still lacked reliable water access.

**Best Evidence For**
- **2024: o ano do combate à fome e redução da pobreza** | Ministério do Desenvolvimento e Assistência Social | 2024-12-23 | https://www.gov.br/mds/pt-br/noticias-e-conteudos/desenvolvimento-social/noticias-desenvolvimento-social/2024-o-ano-do-combate-a-fome-e-reducao-da-pobreza  
  Lula’s social ministry said 24.4 million people left severe food insecurity in 2024 and poverty fell to its lowest level since 2012; Bolsa Família transferred R$168.3 billion to more than 20.86 million families. `6B.3`, also `6B.2`, `6B.1`
- **Governo federal repassa R$ 168,3 bilhões pelo Bolsa Família em 2024** | Ministério do Desenvolvimento e Assistência Social | 2024-12-19 | https://www.gov.br/mds/pt-br/noticias-e-conteudos/desenvolvimento-social/noticias-desenvolvimento-social/governo-federal-repassa-r-168-3-bilhoes-pelo-bolsa-familia-em-2024  
  The program explicitly prioritized households with women and children, plus Indigenous, quilombola, and homeless families. `6B.3`, also `6B.2`, `6B.1`
- **Bolsa Família reduz em 91,7% pobreza na primeira infância** | Ministério do Desenvolvimento e Assistência Social | 2024-04-23 | https://www.gov.br/mds/pt-br/noticias-e-conteudos/desenvolvimento-social/noticias-desenvolvimento-social/bolsa-familia-reduz-em-91-7-pobreza-na-primeira-infancia  
  A government-backed study found Bolsa Família sharply reduced poverty in early childhood, which is direct child-priority evidence. `6B.3`, also `6B.2`
- **Governo federal lança plano com 79 ações para promover a igualdade salarial e laboral entre mulheres e homens** | Ministério das Mulheres | 2024-09-18 | https://www.gov.br/mulheres/pt-br/central-de-conteudos/noticias/2024/setembro/governo-federal-lanca-plano-com-79-acoes-para-promover-a-igualdade-salarial-e-laboral-entre-mulheres-e-homens  
  Lula’s government launched a R$17 billion, 79-action plan to expand women’s labor-market access, permanence, and advancement. `6B.3`, also `6B.1`
- **Governo Federal destina mais de 120 mil hectares a 4,5 mil quilombolas** | Ministério da Igualdade Racial | 2024-09-19 | https://www.gov.br/igualdaderacial/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/governo-federal-destina-mais-de-120-mil-hectares-a-4-5-mil-quilombolas  
  Lula delivered land titles to quilombola communities, a concrete move toward remedying long-standing exclusion of a marginalized Black rural group. `6B.3`, also `6B.1`
- **Conselho Nacional de Política Indigenista é reaberto** / **Lula reafirma compromisso com homologações de terras indígenas e convoca força-tarefa** | Ministério dos Povos Indígenas | 2024-04-16 / 2024-04-26 | https://www.gov.br/povosindigenas/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/04/conselho-nacional-de-politica-indigenista-e-reaberto-com-cerimonia-de-posse-no-palacio-da-justica / https://www.gov.br/povosindigenas/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/04/presidente-lula-reafirma-compromisso-com-homologacoes-de-terras-indigenas-e-convoca-forca-tarefa  
  Lula restored Indigenous consultative institutions and ordered a multi-ministry task force on delayed land homologations. `6B.3`, also `6B.1`
- **Novo PAC selections: health, education, water, sanitation, housing, social infrastructure** | Casa Civil | 2024-03-07 / 2024-07-26 | https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/marco/novo-pac-selecoes-vai-investir-r-23-bilhoes-em-saude-educacao-esporte-e-cultura / https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/julho/novo-pac-selecoes-vai-investir-r-41-7-bi-em-transporte-drenagem-esgotamento-sanitario-abastecimento-de-agua-e-infraestrutura-social-nas-cidades  
  The 2024 PAC allocations targeted low-coverage areas with UBS clinics, schools, creches, drainage, sewage, water supply, and social infrastructure. `6B.3`, also `6B.2`, `6B.1`
- **Saiba mais sobre as ações do Ministério da Saúde voltadas às pessoas com deficiência** | Ministério da Saúde | 2024-12-03 | https://www.gov.br/saude/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/dezembro/saiba-mais-sobre-as-acoes-do-ministerio-da-saude-voltadas-as-pessoas-com-deficiencia  
  The health ministry described expansion of the disability-care network, new rehabilitation centers, and adapted transport as part of the Viver sem Limite plan. `6B.3`, also `6B.2`
- **Decreto institui o Sistema Nacional de Acompanhamento e Combate à Violência nas Escolas** | Presidência da República | 2024-04-24 | https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/decreto/d12006.htm  
  Lula created SNAVE to monitor and combat school violence, a child-focused protection measure. `6B.3`, also `6B.2`

**Best Evidence Against / Caveats**
- **Brazil: Comply with Rulings on Police Violence** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-03-15 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/15/brazil-comply-rulings-police-violence  
  HRW reported lethal raids, intimidation, evidence tampering, and disproportionate police killings in poor and Black communities, showing vulnerable groups were still exposed to severe state harm. `6B.3`
- **Brazil / World Report 2024** | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/brazil  
  HRW said the Yanomami crisis remained severe and that Black Brazilians were disproportionately affected by police abuse. This undercuts any clean claim that vulnerable groups were fully prioritized in practice. `6B.3`
- **WIDER IMAGE-Garimpeiros levam nova onda de sofrimento ao povo Yanomami** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-01-18 | https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/01/18/wider-image-garimpeiros-levam-nova-onda-de-sofrimento-ao-povo-yanomami.htm  
  Reuters reported renewed illegal mining, disease, malnutrition, and fear in Yanomami territory, including threats to basic food and movement. `6B.3`, also `6B.2`
- **Amazon river communities face fresh water shortages** | Reuters via Investing.com / Reuters Connect | 2024-09-08 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/amazon-rivers-low-water-levels-bring-fresh-challenges-for-locals-3606308 / https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/drought-in-brazilian-amazon-causes-water-shortage-for-elderly-and-sick/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjQ6bmV3c21sX1ZBMjU1NzA4MDkyMDI0UlAx  
  Drought left riverine communities, including elderly and sick residents, without reliable drinking water. That shows access gaps remained acute in remote regions. `6B.3`, also `6B.2`
- **Brazil looks at curbing health, education spending in fiscal package, sources say** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-11-05 | https://www.investing.com/news/forex-news/brazil-looks-at-curbing-health-education-spending-in-fiscal-package-sources-say-3703870  
  This was a budget-pressure caveat: even with welfare-heavy programs, fiscal consolidation threatened service expansion. `6B.3`, also `6B.2`

**Search Gap**
- I found strong evidence for children, women, Indigenous people, quilombolas, poor households, and people with disabilities.
- I found little direct 2024 evidence specifically about elderly-focused policy beyond general social protection and basic service access.
- The strongest negative evidence is about implementation failure in policing and Indigenous territory protection, not about Lula lacking a pro-vulnerable-group policy agenda.
